prompt: Full attack then recovery, fixed camera. First crouch low then jump straight up, both boots clearly leave the ground. Hover high in the upper left, knees bent. While airborne spread both arms wide charging blazing energy, then draw both palms together at the chest. Thrust BOTH hands diagonally down and right and unleash one massive sustained fiery energy beam from the palms toward the lower right corner. Hold airborne firing pose as the broad beam surges and flickers, bright yellow core and orange red jagged flame edges. Recoil from the blast. Beam fades, drop back down onto the original ground position, bend knees on landing, return to initial boxing guard. Keep the whole body within the canvas. Crisp chunky pixel art, same pixel size and shading as reference. No sun orb, no text, no camera motion.
